verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's core repo is confirmed open source under AGPL-3.0, explicitly noting the cloud version adds extra features, which supports self-hosting the base scraper. However, community feedback highlights notable gaps versus the hosted product (no built-in proxy service, Puppeteer vs Playwright limitations, missing features like screenshots/html in self-hosted/daemon mode), indicating self-hosting works but with real functional caveats.
